definitions: A deep hole or shaft dug or drilled to obtain water, oil, or gas.
An enclosed space in the centre of a building, allowing light or air to a lower storey.
A container or reservoir for ink in a desk stand or fountain pen.
A source or supply of something.
examples: They dug a well for water.
The light streamed down into the stairwell.
The ink well was almost empty.
She is a well of knowledge.
